mapper.select: SELECT MODEL_VERSION FROM MODEL_REGISTRY WHERE STATUS_CODE = 'ACTIVE' ORDER BY ACTIVATED_AT DESC FETCH FIRST 1 ROWS ONLY

SELECT USER_ID AS userId, WORKER_TYPE_CODE AS workerTypeCode, AGE_BAND_CODE AS ageBandCode, TRAD_SCORE AS tradScore, ALT_SCORE AS altScore, ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS altGradeBandCode, TRAD_GRADE_BAND_CODE AS tradGradeBandCode FROM (SELECT A.USER_ID, A.WORKER_TYPE_CODE, A.AGE_BAND_CODE, A.TRAD_SCORE, A.ALT_SCORE, A.ALT_GRADE_BAND_CODE, A.TRAD_GRADE_BAND_CODE, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY A.USER_ID ORDER BY A.ASSESSED_AT DESC, A.ASSESSMENT_ID DESC) AS RN FROM ASSESSMENT A JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE A.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' AND A.GRADE_STATUS_CODE = 'SCORED' AND A.MODEL_VERSION = #{modelVersion} AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN') WHERE RN = 1 ORDER BY USER_ID
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM APP_USER WHERE ROLE_CODE = 'ROLE_USER' AND ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN'

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM ASSESSMENT A JOIN APP_USER U ON U.USER_ID = A.USER_ID WHERE A.DATASET_CODE = 'SERVICE' AND A.GRADE_STATUS_CODE = 'SCORED' AND U.ACCOUNT_STATUS_CODE <> 'WITHDRAWN' AND A.MODEL_VERSION = #{modelVersion} AND A.ASSESSED_AT >= #{from}
